# Town of Canaan municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 5; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists three Canaan Selectboard members: Dillon Begin (Chair), Alfred Buckley, and Alan Leigh (board Clerk).
Town of Canaan official document, '2026 Elected and Appointed Town Officials': Selectboard: Dillon G. Begin (Chair), Alfred Buckley (Vice Chair), Alan B. Leigh.
Town of Canaan official document, '2026 Elected and Appointed Town Officials': Moderator: Ashley Morgan Wade.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Zachary Brown as Town Clerk of Canaan and as Town Treasurer of Canaan.
Town of Canaan official document, '2026 Elected and Appointed Town Officials': Town Clerk and Treasurer: Zachary William Brown (the fuller form the town prints).

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Zachary Brown as Town Clerk of Canaan and as Town Treasurer of Canaan.
Town of Canaan official document, '2026 Elected and Appointed Town Officials': Town Clerk and Treasurer: Zachary William Brown (the fuller form the town prints).

Town of Canaan official document, '2026 Elected and Appointed Town Officials': Listers: Noreen J. Labrecque, Gordon (Tom) Trammell, Tana Trammell. The nickname form is the town's; the record carries the plain name.
Town of Canaan official document, '2026 Elected and Appointed Town Officials': Auditors: Fern Owen-Brown, Ursula Johnson, Ginette Ladd.

Town of Canaan official document, '2026 Elected and Appointed Town Officials': the Delinquent Tax Collector, Dencie Cunningham, is listed in the document's appointed-officers section; she is recorded as an appointed holder of the separately filled office (17 V.S.A. section 2651d).

Town of Canaan official document, '2026 Elected and Appointed Town Officials': Trustees of Public Funds: Dencie Cunningham, Zachary W. Brown, and one position printed VACANT; the vacant seat is left unfilled.

Town of Canaan official document, '2026 Elected and Appointed Town Officials': Library Trustees (elected board of five): Sharon H. Belleville, Shellie Bresnahan, Georgiana Carr, Nancy Petro, Kathy Smith.

Town of Canaan official document, '2026 Elected and Appointed Town Officials': the Grand Juror, Fern Owen-Brown, is listed in the document's appointed-officers section; she is recorded as an appointed holder.

Town of Canaan official document, '2026 Elected and Appointed Town Officials': the Town Agent, Ryan D. Porter, is listed in the document's appointed-officers section; he is recorded as an appointed holder.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Canaan justices of the peace: Fern Owen-Brown, Renee Marchesseault, Judith Masson, Frank Sawicki Jr., and Katie Sawicki.
Town of Canaan official document, '2026 Elected and Appointed Town Officials': the town's officials list prints the same five justices of the peace.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Canaan justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office.
